summary: RGC Resources, Inc. filed an 8-K on May 6, 2026, reporting its second quarter earnings for the period ended March 31, 2026. The filing includes a press release disclosing net income of $8.7 million ($0.84 per diluted share) for Q2 FY2026, compared to $7.7 million ($0.74 per diluted share) in Q2 FY2025, attributed to higher operating margins and lower interest expense. The filing also references an ongoing rate case with the Virginia State Corporation Commission. No special situation event is present; this is a routine earnings results report.
